spec_refined.title: New composite: search input with combo results dropdown
spec_refined.description: Add a search combo pattern: a search-styled text input that opens a results menu as the user types, supporting keyboard navigation, an empty-results state, and a loading state. Built by composing existing text-input, menu and icon components; exposed as a new component modus-wc-search-combo.
acceptance_criteria: Typing >= minChars opens the results menu; clearing closes it
Results menu supports ArrowUp/ArrowDown navigation and Enter selection
Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the input
Empty state renders a configurable no-results message
loading prop renders a spinner in the menu instead of items
Selection emits itemSelect with the selected item's value
Component follows library conventions: tailwind.ts, stories, spec tests, readme
a11y: combobox ARIA pattern (role=combobox, aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant)
spec_refined.technical_notes: Greenfield composite touching multiple existing components' APIs; conventions matter (this is where MCP/rules context should show value).
